sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent tactical-map mouse command badge for a cold-steel strategy game. This badge will sit beside an existing mouse arrow; DO NOT draw an arrow-shaped mouse pointer. Design a crisp, very readable 3D embossed metal emblem, frontal orthographic view, broad satin silver faces, charcoal gunmetal bevels, dark separation seams, restrained brushed metal texture, neutral soft light from upper left. A compact bold silhouette that remains unmistakable at 32 CSS pixels. Genuine transparent RGBA background, clean antialiased edges, no checkerboard, no opaque background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no label, no UI board, no border enclosing the icon, no extra objects. Center the emblem in a square canvas with consistent generous transparent padding, symbol occupies about 72 percent of width and height. Avoid photoreal clutter, tiny rivets, ornate decoration, gold and neon glows. Symbol: two parallel broad upward-pointing chevrons, one above the other, like a tactical forward-march insignia. Satin silver faces, slim muted ice-blue inlay only in the middle of each chevron. Clear separation between the two chevrons. No shafts, no compass, no wings.
